chunks.text: Everyday Account overdraft fee: $10 per day when the balance is more than $10 below the approved overdraft limit. Monthly cap $50.
Business Account overdraft fee: $15 per day when the balance is more than $50 below the approved limit. Monthly cap $150.
Corporate Account overdraft fee: $25 per day when the balance is more than $500 below the approved limit. Monthly cap $500.
Student Account overdraft fee: $5 per day when the balance is more than $10 below the approved limit. Monthly cap $25.
Premier Account overdraft fee: waived for the first 5 days in any calendar month, then $5 per day. Monthly cap $75.
